text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line now! Kitasan 
Black once again conquers the distance! 
2,200 meters poses no problem for her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Yes, I saw it through! Even at 
this distance, I managed to keep up a 
great pace all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I might not be flashy. But I'll just push 
forward and give it my all until the 
finish line. This is—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My way of running! My way of living! This 
is the only way, my one and only path--!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. I'm neither a genius nor an 
elite. That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is tackle things head-on, 
giving it everything and steadily building 
it up. And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will make it there. With this way of 
doing things, I'll reach that grand stage 
where only the truly strong Umamusume can 
stand!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black, huh... She lacks a decisive 
closing burst, so it's always nail-biting 
wondering when she'll be overtaken, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it's kinda nice. That vibe of 
giving it everything they've got. 
Especially today...”

That's right. Kita-chan always gives it 
everything she's got!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh, you are...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond?! I-Is that the real 
deal...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is going to get much stronger 
from here on out. That is why...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Please support her going forward. She is 
a truly wonderful Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan! You came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks for a great run. Also, 
there's something I wanted to report to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Looks like my debut is coming up too. 
Finally, to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!? Really, Dia-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm still far away from where 
Kita-chan is, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely catch up to you. So do 
your best in the Kikuka Sho too, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah! Of course I want to run with 
Dia-chan someday. It's the most important 
promise of all! But before that...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"There's an Umamusume I absolutely have to 
surpass... someone I need to settle things 
with!"

"A massive barrier—the strongest elite of 
their generation, 'Bruskman.'"

Kitasan Black cannot move forward unless 
she defeats that Umamusume at the Kikuka 
Sho.
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-This is terrible, Kitasan Black, 
Trainer! Turn on the news right now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
Turning on the TV, there was――

There stood Brusqueman's Trainer, 
surrounded by a crowd of reporters.

text_block_list.name: Talented Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Surgery. We noticed a slight 
abnormality after the Derby, and while we 
were discussing what to do—

text_block_list.name: Talented Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I will not enter Brusqueman in the Kikuka 
Sho. I will have her focus on recuperating 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Scratching from the race!? 
Trainer...!

I nod lightly and shift my brain into 
overdrive. Without the strongest rival in 
the field, our entire strategy will have 
to be reworked from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if she'll be okay... Even if she 
is, the Kikuka Sho is already out of 
the..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"And just when I felt like I could finally 
put everything I felt into it..."
choice_data_list: Let's just calm down for a second.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, I'm sorry! It was just so sudden.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have to switch gears. Even if I can't do 
it right away, bit by bit...!

The Twinkle Series is never simple. The 
moment one worry cleared up, a brand-new 
situation arose.

She must run well in the Kikuka Sho, even 
without her greatest rival there.
